subject.title: improve: let Code Mode use declared tool result shapes

question: Should `outputSchema` become the supported optional plugin API for describing and validating `AgentToolResult.details` across Code Mode and Tool Search?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but accepting a new exported plugin field and its validation lifecycle is a durable compatibility and ownership decision that automated review cannot make.

options.title: Approve the shared contract
options.body: Accept the optional field and documented validation semantics as the single result-shape contract shared by Code Mode and Tool Search.

options.title: Keep result hints internal
options.body: Do not expose a public plugin field yet; limit output hints to internally owned tools until the external API lifecycle is designed separately.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared contract
recommendation.body: Accept the optional field and documented validation semantics as the single result-shape contract shared by Code Mode and Tool Search.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the current Code Mode catalog and execution behavior, and they have the strongest recent history on the exact surface.
